answer: A reputation-weighted stake garden resists Sybil attacks by making identity expensive: each agent must lock a refundable deposit that grows with the value it moves, and the deposit is slashed on verified fraud. New identities start at the horizon with near-zero trust and earn standing only through small verifiable jobs before reaching the summit of full trading limits. Creating a thousand fake agents then means locking a thousand deposits, so attacker cost scales linearly while honest agents pay nothing extra.
